nom: Jack Black Face Buff Energizing Scrub with Vitamin C & Mint

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily-leaning routines report the scrub clears blackheads/whiteheads around the nose and helps keep oil in check through the day, though one felt it left an oil residue instead of cleansing it away.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports it works well on and around the nose for black/whiteheads despite that skin type.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer notes it might be too abrasive for sensitive skin, though she herself uses it without issue.
segments.mature: A reviewer using it for years alongside a moisturizer reports smoother, healthier skin over time, describing it as part of an older user's steady regimen.

concerns.aging: One long-term user pairing it with a moisturizer reports skin that is smoother and healthier than it has ever been.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report soft or smooth skin afterward with no dryness, but two note the product left their face feeling dry or in need of extra moisturizer, and one recommends following with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One user reports the scrub soothes post-shave irritation and reduces razor bumps and ingrown hairs; another warns the larger beads can cut skin and cause irritation bumps if overused.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer switched from CeraVe, which left a beard dry and itchy, and reports a noticeable improvement after switching to this scrub.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the scrub works well on blackheads and whiteheads, especially around the nose, and helps with ingrown facial hairs; one used it specifically to treat folliculitis and saw improvement after about 8 weeks.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with lifelong problem skin reports acne staying under control with regular use; no other reviewer discusses breakouts, so this is a single account rather than a consistent pattern.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports the scrub removes oil and keeps the face feeling clean through the day, while another reports the opposite: an oily residue remained after washing with a newer batch.

aspects.libelle: Some prefer the new coarser formula
Pump or tube clogging over time
Higher price seen as worth it

extraits.titre: Not like the old formula, micro beads are coarse
extraits.texte: Micro-beads are coarse and just hurts your skin rather than gently peeling off the dead skin. After I was my face with it, I feel like my face is not cleansed and there is still some oil residue. Not like the old formula at all. Definitely it's not worth the price

Last year I gave this 5 stars but, this year it's been very disappointing. Consistently, for the past several purchases, the bamboo powder (tiny exfoliation granules) has been more akin to bamboo grains. The granules were big to the point that instead of being an gentle abrasive, it was cutting my skin and causing bumps from irritation. As I said before, this used to be amazing product but after so many let downs from purchases, I've completely lost faith in the product and am now searching for another exfoliant.
I love this exfoliating cleanser! It cleans well and makes my face soft. It might be too abrasive for sensitive skin though.

extraits.titre: Does miracles to your skin. Especially if you have a beard
extraits.texte: I have a beard and I usually use CERAVE. it was leaving my beard dry and itchy i started using this. The first try you will feel a huge difference. I use it 2-3 times a week. Absolutely amazing!!!!!

extraits.titre: Jack Black Face Buff Energizing Scrub with Vitamin C & Mint
extraits.texte: I have been looking for a solution to folliculitis, facial hair infection for over five years. Jack Black face buff scrub seems to be helping. I does take some time to change facial complexion, about 8 weeks, but I now enjoy it every morning in the shower. Highly recommend giving it a try. It took me a couple of tubes and daily use to notice a difference. Be patient, this is a good product.

Absolutely love this scrub. I use it 3 to 4 times a week to keep the acne at bay. I've had problem skin my entire life and now that I've switched over to Jack Black products it's finally under control. My wife loves it too! She asked me to get her one for when she's on the road.
A staple in my husband's skin care regimen. He uses it 1-2 times a week before cleansing, and combined with his Jack Black moisturizer, his skin is smoother and healthier than it's ever been.
